record_identity.title: Amendment-Level Provenance Metadata and Ledger Validation Migration

summary: Migrated governed Caelestis Constitution and Charter instruments from static document-level authorship and review blocks to amendment-specific Agent, Model and Reviewer provenance in a canonical seven-column Amendment Ledger; preserved historical versions, summaries, timestamps and hashes; and updated parsing, validation, repair, generation, documentation and tests for deterministic operation.
why_it_matters_to_CAM: Static document-level authorship and review statements could not accurately represent who drafted or reviewed each amendment cycle and risked implying continuing or third-party review that had not occurred. Amendment-level provenance makes the change history more precise and auditable while retaining the corpus's existing acceptance and sealing model.

decision_trace.decision_summary: FM-0034 identifies broader governance drift and provenance loss. This PATCH supplies a bounded partial repair at the amendment-record layer only: provenance travels with each amendment row, while constitutional persistence, successor safeguards, capture resistance, notice, appeal and independent oversight remain unresolved.

events.description: VIGIL-2026-FM-0034 identified governance drift, loss of preserved amendment rationale and lineage, and weakening of durable safeguards as part of a broader institutional failure.

corpus_implementation.implementation_outcome: One hundred governed instruments now use the canonical seven-column Amendment Ledger. Historical rows retain their original version, summary, timestamp and Reference Hash while adding Caelen, GPT-5 Series and Dr M.V. O'Rourke. Static Authorship & Stewardship and Review & Validation blocks were removed. New latest migration rows were sealed subject to the existing allowlisted blank-hash exceptions. Parsers, validators, repair tools, generators, workflows, documentation and regression tests now resolve canonical headers and the final Reference Hash column deterministically.

change_details.implementation_notes: No separate Review Status column or authorship registry was created. No third-party review was inferred. The one derived no-ledger registry exception and two pre-existing allowlisted blank-hash exceptions retain their established treatment.
